title: avoid full clone / traversal for _extra_criteria if no bound parameters

labels.name: performance
labels.description: where performance can be improved.  add "bug" only if it's a performance degradation

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/11079

the change in #10570 adds perf overhead which can be severe for very large and complex query structures

the test here needs to be an aaa_performance test , there's no other way to check this

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/strategy_options.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/strategy_options.py
index c20215ac3..c23e440c5 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/strategy_options.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/strategy_options.py
@@ -1034,6 +1034,8 @@ class Load(_AbstractLoad):
     def _adapt_cached_option_to_uncached_option(
         self, context: QueryContext, uncached_opt: ORMOption
     ) -> ORMOption:
+        if uncached_opt is self:
+            return self
         return self._adjust_for_extra_criteria(context)
 
     def _prepend_path(self, path: PathRegistry) -> Load:
@@ -1058,6 +1060,15 @@ class Load(_AbstractLoad):
         def process(opt: _LoadElement) -> _LoadElement:
             nonlocal orig_cache_key, replacement_cache_key, found_crit
 
+            for elem in opt._extra_criteria:
+                eck = elem._generate_cache_key()
+                if eck.bindparams:
+                    break
+            else:
+                return opt
+
+            cloned_opt = opt._clone()
+
             found_crit = True
 
             if orig_cache_key is None or replacement_cache_key is None:
@@ -1067,20 +1078,20 @@ class Load(_AbstractLoad):
             if replacement_cache_key is not None:
                 assert orig_cache_key is not None
 
-                opt._extra_criteria = tuple(
+                cloned_opt._extra_criteria = tuple(
                     replacement_cache_key._apply_params_to_element(
                         orig_cache_key, crit
                     )
-                    for crit in opt._extra_criteria
+                    for crit in cloned_opt._extra_criteria
                 )
 
-            return opt
+            return cloned_opt
 
         # avoid generating cache keys for the queries if we don't
         # actually have any extra_criteria options, which is the
         # common case
         new_context = tuple(
-            process(value._clone()) if value._extra_criteria else value
+            process(value) if value._extra_criteria else value
             for value in self.context
         )

```
